verdict.rationale: Belvo is an open-finance API platform with SDKs, a Connect widget and MCP servers, so asking whether users can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out, privacy toggle, or data-collection control. The security and privacy-related community comments cover encryption claims and credential handling, not telemetry, so they are not relevant here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
